entities.name: Walid
entities.description: A pious man blessed with many sons, jewels and Camels.

entities.name: King Suleiman
entities.description: A king for whom tempestuous winds and many devils were made obedient, called Solomon in the quotation.

entities.name: Saffiyah
entities.description: A woman who summoned twenty flying men to her side.

entities.name: Ouallada
entities.description: Speaker of a line about visiting when darkness comes.

entities.name: Ali Baba
entities.description: A figure who pronounced the words 'Open, Sesame!' at the cavern entrance.

entities.name: Sarsour
entities.description: A man against whom the landscape itself turned in a sandstorm.

entities.name: Maimun al-Wyluli
entities.description: Diarist who wrote about wolves that eat scorpions.

entities.name: Aladdin
entities.description: A youth on whose finger a magician placed a ring.

entities.name: Aladdin's Ring
entities.description: A ring the magician called a talisman against all evil so long as Aladdin obeys him.

entities.name: Jandor
entities.description: A traveler whose saddlebags were full of food each day.

entities.name: Island of Wak-Wak
entities.description: Home to a tribe of winged folk, named for a fruit that speaks the word 'Wak'.

events.summary: Saffiyah claps her hands and twenty flying men appear at her side.
events.quote: Saffiyah clapped her hands and twenty flying men appeared at her side

events.summary: A sandstorm rises against Sarsour and rearranges the landscape so he is lost.
events.quote: Even the landscape turned against Sarsour, first rising up and pelting him, then rearranging itself so he could no longer find his way.

events.summary: Ali Baba reaches the cavern entrance and speaks the words 'Open, Sesame!'
events.quote: When he reached the entrance of the cavern, he pronounced the words, 'Open, Sesame!'

events.summary: The magician puts a talisman ring on Aladdin's finger.
events.quote: the magician drew a ring off his finger, and put it on one of Aladdin's

events.summary: Jandor finds his saddlebags full of food each day of the journey.
events.quote: Each day of their journey, Jandor opened the saddlebags and found them full of mutton, quinces, cheese, date rolls, wine, and all manner of delicious and satisfying foods.

relations.note: The ring is a talisman so long as Aladdin obeys the magician.
relations.quote: It is a talisman against all evil, so long as you obey me.
